longTitle.officialTitle: To amend chapter 97 of title 28, United States Code, to clarify the exception to foreign sovereign immunity set forth in section 1605(a)(3) of such title.

main.enactingFormula: Be it enacted by the Senate and House of Representatives of the United States of America in Congress assembled,

section.heading: SHORT TITLE.
section.content: This Act may be cited as the “Foreign Cultural Exchange Jurisdictional Immunity Clarification Act”.

section.heading: CLARIFICATION OF JURISDICTIONAL IMMUNITY OF FOREIGN STATES.

subsection.heading: In general.—
Effective Date.—
subsection.content: The amendment made by this section shall apply to any civil action commenced on or after the date of the enactment of this Act.

section.heading: NOTIFICATION.
section.content: The Secretary of State shall ensure that foreign states that apply for immunity under Public Law 89-259 (22 U.S.C. 2459) are appropriately notified of the text of this Act.
